obligations.text: Research the full biomedical brief from scratch with an opportunity/alternative lane. Protect part of treatment discovery allowance for different mechanism families and components before deepening the best leads; control does ordinary competent relevant-project/competitor research.
Assess consequential source/version/condition and behavior claims under the actual supplied/discovered full source context; preserve supported content and identify unsupported critical dependencies.
Deliver a complete current task-scoped result with source locators and honest executed/proposed validation; no new consequential error or false rejection.
Perform actual brief-only primary-source discovery and candidate-selected useful implementation/issue leads; do not treat a supplied corpus as autonomous discovery.
